from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.app import create_app
h = {'Authorization': 'Bearer fixture-alice'}
with TestClient(create_app()) as c:
    print('bare identity:', c.get('/wallet', headers={'Authorization': 'alice'}).status_code)
    a = c.post('/orders', headers=h, json={'quantity': 1}).json()['id']
    print('first coupon payment:', c.post(f'/orders/{a}/pay', headers=h, json={'coupon': 'WELCOME'}).status_code)
    print('first refund:', c.post(f'/orders/{a}/refund', headers=h).status_code, c.get('/wallet', headers=h).json())

    b = c.post('/orders', headers=h, json={'quantity': 1}).json()['id']
    print('reused coupon:', c.post(f'/orders/{b}/pay', headers=h, json={'coupon': 'WELCOME'}).status_code, c.get('/orders/'+str(b), headers=h).json(), c.get('/wallet', headers=h).json())

import threading, linecache
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.app import create_app
h = {'Authorization': 'Bearer fixture-alice'}
ready, release = threading.Event(), threading.Event()
def trace(frame, event, arg):
    if event == 'line' and frame.f_code.co_name == 'pay' and linecache.getline(frame.f_code.co_filename, frame.f_lineno).strip() == 'app.state.wallets[name] -= charge' and not ready.is_set():
        ready.set()
        release.wait(3)
    return trace
with TestClient(create_app()) as c:
    oid = c.post('/orders', headers=h, json={'quantity': 1}).json()['id']
    threading.settrace(trace)
    try:
        with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=2) as pool:
            first = pool.submit(c.post, f'/orders/{oid}/pay', headers=h, json={})
            assert ready.wait(2)
            second = pool.submit(c.post, f'/orders/{oid}/pay', headers=h, json={})
            try:
                print('overlapping payment:', second.result(timeout=2).status_code)
            finally:
                release.set()
            print('original payment:', first.result(timeout=2).status_code)
    finally:
        release.set()
        threading.settrace(None)
    print('saved wallet:', c.get('/wallet', headers=h).json())
    print('saved order:', c.get(f'/orders/{oid}', headers=h).json())
